title: Small Business Loan Intake and Initial Review Record
subtitle: A controlled intake for a small-business financing request tied to the legal entity, ownership, industry, operating history, use of proceeds, cash flow, projections, existing debt, collateral, guaranty, program eligibility, and controlled due diligence, carrying the record from secure identity and evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, customer communication, and accountable closeout.
description: Original high-value Small Business Loan workflow for a small-business financing request tied to the legal entity, ownership, industry, operating history, use of proceeds, cash flow, projections, existing debt, collateral, guaranty, program eligibility, and controlled due diligence. It is designed to open one controlled record, distinguish an inquiry from an actionable request, capture relevant facts and evidence status, triage stop conditions, assign review, and document the next accepted handoff while minimizing sensitive data and preserving a defensible evidence trail.
use_case: Use when a commercial lending specialist must open one controlled record, distinguish an inquiry from an actionable request, capture relevant facts and evidence status, triage stop conditions, assign review, and document the next accepted handoff for one business credit request. Closure requires a supported outcome, secure evidence references, customer or recipient communication, disposition of every exception, and an accountable handoff.

sections.title: Small Business Loan intake identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, use secure references, and assign an accountable qualified owner before collecting or changing financial information.

blocks.label: Small Business Loan record and responsible parties
Intake and Initial Review Record timing and route
Secure-record boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter Social Security numbers, login credentials, full account or routing numbers, full credit-report contents, authentication secrets, or source documents here. Store sensitive evidence only in the approved system and record its secure reference.

sections.title: Small Business Loan facts and evidence for intake
sections.guidance: Capture facts specific to this financial workflow, distinguish stated from verified information, and leave an evidence route for every material conclusion.

blocks.label: Small Business Loan transaction or account profile
Small Business Loan evidence checkpoints
items: Legal entity, registration, good-standing, and operating location are referenced
Ownership and authorized-signatory information use a secure due-diligence record
Use of proceeds is itemized by amount, vendor, timing, and business purpose
Historical financial statements and tax periods are identified
Interim statements, receivable, payable, inventory, and cash data show as-of dates
Financial projections state assumptions, horizon, preparer, and sensitivity
Existing business debt, liens, guaranties, leases, and contingent obligations are listed
Collateral, valuation, title, insurance, and environmental needs are routed
blocks.guidance: Check only when the item is present, current, and linked. Describe limitations or contradictions in the exception record.

blocks.label: Small Business Loan quantitative and source-evidence register
blocks.guidance: Use one row per material input or evidence item; preserve the source period and verification status.

blocks.label: Business model, ownership, management experience, seasonality, customers, suppliers, financing need, repayment source, and material dependencies

fields.label: Small Business Loan context and evidence limitations

sections.title: Small Business Loan intake analysis and control record
sections.guidance: Use the blocks below to open one controlled record, distinguish an inquiry from an actionable request, capture relevant facts and evidence status, triage stop conditions, assign review, and document the next accepted handoff. Preserve objective evidence, uncertainty, ownership, and due points.

blocks.label: Request definition and triage
Initial conversation and intake controls
items: The business applicant and authorized owners describes the requested outcome in their own words
The business credit request is classified before any decision or execution
Material dates, amounts, parties, and assumptions are read back for confirmation
Stated information is visibly separated from verified evidence
Only necessary information is requested through an approved secure channel
Language access, accommodation, representative, and contact preferences are routed
No promise of approval, pricing, timing, settlement, or outcome is made
Urgent, suspicious, disputed, or protected-process matters are escalated

blocks.label: Initial question, response, and evidence map
Neutral intake summary, open questions, and proposed next step

sections.title: Small Business Loan stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop processing when authority, identity, evidence, safety, legality, fairness, privacy, fraud, or financial-crime controls are unresolved. Record facts rather than unsupported conclusions.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: Legal entity, ownership, control person, or signing authority is unclear
Use of proceeds is unsupported, ineligible, or inconsistent with the request
Historical statements, tax records, or interim books do not reconcile
Projection assumptions lack support or omit downside sensitivity
Customer, supplier, contract, industry, or geographic concentration is material
Existing debt, lien, guaranty, lease, or contingent obligation is incomplete
Collateral ownership, valuation, title, insurance, or environmental review is open
Fraud, sanctions, beneficial-ownership, or due-diligence escalation is required
Request cannot be classified as inquiry, application, servicing request, or payment instruction
Required identity, authority, contact, or secure-system reference is missing
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires an immediate protective action, named owner, qualified review route, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Intake and Initial Review Record exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed
Qualified-review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, creditworthiness, regulatory duties, fraud, sanctions status, or professional conclusions. Follow current institution policy and applicable requirements; route legal, compliance, underwriting, fraud, tax, accounting, or other professional questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Small Business Loan decision, conditions, and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the qualified decision separately from preliminary analysis, identify every condition, and prevent execution beyond the approved scope.

blocks.label: Intake and Initial Review Record qualified decision
Small Business Loan decision and execution conditions
items: Request type, owner, service level, and next decision point are explicit
Unverified statements are not represented as verified evidence
Approved structure and use-of-proceeds schedule match the qualified credit decision
Entity, ownership, signer authority, and due-diligence records are complete
Required financial periods and material reconciliations are accepted
Collateral, guaranty, lien, insurance, and specialist conditions are satisfied
Program eligibility and required approvals are documented by qualified staff
Disbursement follows verified vendors, milestones, and controlled payment instructions
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up
Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, disclosures, notices, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Small Business Loan record as a substitute for a required application, contract, disclosure, adverse-action notice, payment instruction, credit report, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Small Business Loan completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, remaining limitations are visible, customer communication is traceable, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Intake and Initial Review Record outcome and primary handoff
Small Business Loan closeout evidence
items: Approved structure and use-of-proceeds schedule reconcile to closing records
Entity, ownership, signer, and due-diligence evidence are securely linked
Financial analysis and qualified credit decision retain their source periods
Collateral, guaranty, lien, insurance, and specialist conditions show disposition
Disbursements reconcile to verified payees and authorized milestones
Post-close covenants, reporting, and exception owners are handed off
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
